target: call_sol.sh — the adversary request declares a response schema requiring location
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; printf %s '{"objective":"adversarially review the candidate","user_intent_verbatim":"","input_paths":[],"boundaries_non_goals":[],"output_spec":"findings with locations","effort_budget":"one pass"}' | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/findings/sol-response-located.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -e '.text.format.type == "json_schema" and (.text.format.schema.properties.findings.items.required | index("location") != null) and ([.text.format.schema.properties.findings.items.properties.location | .. | objects | select(has("required")) | .required[]] | (index("file") != null and index("line_start") != null and index("line_end") != null))' "$D"
